title: Mountain Men

title: The Green Way Outdoors
description: Kyle and Jeff head to the nation's capital and the Chesapeake Bay to investigate the controversy surrounding cownose rays and their disputed impact on the crabbing industry. A crab distributor, a bowfishing guide who targets the rays, an animal rights activist, fishermen, and a restaurant owner share competing perspectives as the team explores how these migratory animals should be managed.

title: The Green Way Outdoors
description: Kyle and Jeff trace Ernest Hemingway's fishing legacy, hearing childhood fishing stories from his great-nephew in Michigan. They learn how Hemingway inspired Captain Darrin's Atlantic pursuit of Giant Bluefin Tuna, then recreate a tuna fight using century-old fishing equipment Hemingway helped develop. They finish by trout fishing in Ketchum, Idaho, where Hemingway spent his final years.

title: History's Mystery Files
description: The search for treasure doesn't always lead to ancient ruins; sometimes, priceless history is concealed inside a home, buried among unwanted possessions, or waiting unnoticed at a garage sale.

description: Across the globe, certain locations seem to resist explanation; from Japan's infamous "suicide forest" and enigmatic Knights Templar tunnels, to a top-secret wartime compound in Virginia; each holds clues to mysteries that have endured for generations.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description: A miracle cure with a deadly catch; A romantic gesture explodes in a president's face; A simple home repair spirals wildly out of control; Sometimes the biggest disasters begin with the best intentions.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description: How did a pet pig spring into action to save its owner's life? Which mysterious spirits became the unlikely heroes that turned the tide for a doomed flight? title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description: Exploring the Lake Michigan Triangle and many other wild and weird places, including a doll-filled island with a dark past, deadly gas-filled explosive lakes, caves that harbor deadly viruses and a haunted place in the United States.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
